title: How to visit Innopolis VM
content: How to visit Innopolis VM# Open your web browser and type Innopolis VM in the address bar. Then you will be redirected to the SSO Innopolis University login page. If you are immediately redirected to Innopolis VM, don’t worry, most likely you are already logged in. If you are not logged in, you will be prompted to enter your Innopolis University credentials (username and password). Then click on the “Login” button. You will be redirected to the main page of the website.

title: Subscriptions
content: How to create a subscription# From the main page of the website, click on the “New” button in the left bottom corner. The new menu will open - click “MY ACCOUNT”. Click on the “ADD SUBSCRIPTION” button. Modal with subscription creation form will open. Depending on who you are (student, instructor, worker), you will have different options for subscription creation. For example, for students, you can create a subscription for a specific course or general StudentPublic subscription. If you want a specific subscription, you need to contact IT department of Innopolis University. The details of the concrete subscription type will appear on the right side of the form when you click it. When you choose the subscription type - click it and then click a tick button on the right bottom corner. Then you need to wait while the subscription is being created. Some time your subscription will have the “Syncing” status. Don’t worry, just wait until it will be “Active”. After a while, your subscription will change its status to “Active”. Where to find your subscriptions# From the main page of the website, click on the “My Account” button in the left bar. Click on the “SUBSCRIPTIONS” section. You can see all your subscriptions.

title: Create Virtual Machine
content: How to create a new virtual machine# At first, you need to have a subscription to the service (see Subscriptions). From the main page of the website, click on the “VIRTUAL MACHINES” button in the left bar. On the Virtual Machines page, click on the right arrow button OR if you have already created some virtual machines, click on the “New” button in the left bottom corner and then “STANDALONE VIRTUAL MACHINE”. In the opened menu you can choose a template for creating a virtual machine: quick start or from gallery. How to create a new virtual machine from quick start# Menu with quick start creating will open. Here you need to write the name of your virtual machine into “NAME” field. Name is required. Also choose the subscription type - depending on it you can choose different templates (operating systems) for virtual machine. Then choose the template (operating system) for your virtual machine. Write and confirm the new password for your virtual machine. If you see the red exclamation mark in the “PASSWORD” field then the condition on the password is not satisfied (see Password requirements). “ADMINISTRATOR ACCOUNT” may be filled by default and can’t be changed. But in some cases you are required to write your own name inside the field. Save your password, administrator account and ssh key or product key, because you will not be able to see them again. If all fields are filled correctly - click the “CREATE VM INSTANCE” button. To see the details of creation - click on the “DETAILS” button. You can see the progress of creation of your virtual machine here. On the Virtual Machines page you can see your virtual machine. For some time its status will be “Creating”, then it will change to “Running”.

title: Create VM from Gallery
content: How to create a new virtual machine from gallery# Menu with gallery creating will open. You can choose the different operating system for your virtual machine and see the details. When you have chosen, click right arrow button. Menu with settings of your virtual machine will open. Now you need to write the name of your virtual machine into “NAME” field. Name is required. Write and confirm the new password for your virtual machine. If you see the red exclamation mark in the “PASSWORD” field then the condition on the password is not satisfied (see Password requirements). If you see the red exclamation mark in the “CONFIRM” field then the password and confirm password are not equal. “ADMINISTRATOR ACCOUNT” may be filled by default and can’t be changed. But in some cases you are required to write your own name inside the field. Also you can write your ssh key into the “SSH KEY” field or product key into the “PRODUCT KEY” field. This is not required. Save your password, administrator account and ssh key or product key, because you will not be able to see them again. When you have filled all fields, click the right arrow button. Then you can set your virtual machine network adapter - where your vm be available. Now you can click tick button to save your settings and create virtual machine.

title: Connect to VM
content:
How to connect to your virtual machine# You have several options to connect to your virtual machine:
You can use the clients or applications for ssh connection. For example, PuTTY for Windows, or MobaXterm for Windows, Linux and Mac. But for this option you need to configure the “SSH KEY” during creating virtual machine. You can use the connect to your virtual machine from the browser (see below). Connect to your virtual machine using its IP by another software (see below). How to see the IP of the virtual machine# On the page of your virtual machine dashboard on the right side you can see the IP of your virtual machine. The IP looks like this: 10.13.127.89. If there is no IP - see section “How to create a virtual machine with an explicit IP” (will be updated soon). How to connect to your virtual machine from the browser# From the page of your virtual machine dashboard, click on the “CONNECT” button on the bottom. Then you can choose two options to connect to your virtual machine, to connect from the browser, click “WebConsole”. The new browser window will open with your virtual machine console. You need to write your vm login (see What is my virtual machine login) and type enter. And then you need to write your vm password and type enter. If you see the message like “Login is incorrect”. It means that you wrote incorrect login or password. Try again with correct login and password. If you successfully connected to your virtual machine, you can see the message “Welcome to Ubuntu…” or something else depending on your virtual machine operating system.

title: Details & Credentials
content:
How to see details of the created virtual machine# From the main page of the website, click on the “VIRTUAL MACHINES” button in the left bar. Choose the virtual machine you want to see the details of and click on its name. Then you can see the page with your virtual machine. If you want to see details, click “DASHBOARD” button. Then you can see the page with your virtual machine dashboard. What is my virtual machine login# At first, you can’t see the login of your virtual machine when you have already created it. But more likely it is “root”, “admin”, or “administrator”. You can see the login of your virtual machine during vm creation. For “QUICK START” option, you can see the login in the “ADMINISTRATOR ACCOUNT” section. The login is most likely lower-case instead of upper-case. Or you are required to fulfill it. For “FROM GALLERY” option, you can see the login in the “ADMINISTRATOR ACCOUNT” section. Password requirements# The password must contain 3 of the following:
a lowercase character an uppercase character a number a special character Example: MyP@ssw0rd123!

title: Troubleshooting
content:
Troubleshooting# If your screen became gray and you can’t click anything: On the bottom you can see a message “Your session timed out. Click OK to log again”. Don’t worry, click “OK”. You either need to log in again or just be redirected to main page.
Subscription is syncing too long: If your subscription is syncing too long - don’t worry, more likely it is active right now and you can use it. If it is not, contact IT department of Innopolis University.
Virtual machine is creating too long: If your virtual machine is creating too long, try to delete and create virtual machine again. If you tried to do it several times, contact IT department of Innopolis University.
Virtual machine is failed to create: If you got such a message during creating a vm you can see the details by clicking “i” button. Try to recreate virtual machine. If you tried to do it several times, contact IT department of Innopolis University. If you have forgotten your password: Contact IT department of Innopolis University.
